T006 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  E.Nonempty →
    ScaleLaws ∧ CriticalLaws ∧ InvarianceLaws ∧ PowerLaws →
      ((∃ R, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (j : Fin n), |x.ofLp j| ≤ R) ∧
          Bornology.IsBounded E ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → content s δ E < ∞) →
        (0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n) ∧ (n = 0 → E = univ ∧ dimH E = 0)
'Translation.T006' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
